{{short description|British physicist}}
'''Peter John Dornan''' [[Fellow of the Royal Society|FRS]] (born 1939) is a British [[physicist]], and professor at [[Imperial College London]] where he advised his PhD student [[Ann Heinson]].<ref>{{Cite web|url=http://www3.imperial.ac.uk/people/p.dornan|title=Imperial College London}}</ref>

On 18 September 2009, a [[festschrift]] was held in his honor.<ref>{{Cite web|url=http://www3.imperial.ac.uk/newsandeventspggrp/imperialcollege/naturalsciences/highenergyphysics/eventssummary/event_29-7-2011-15-2-31|title = Imperial College London}}</ref> Dornan was awarded the [[Rutherford Medal and Prize]] in 2002.<ref>{{cite web |url=https://www.iop.org/about/awards/subject/rutherford/medallists/page_38596.html |title=Rutherford medal recipients |website=www.iop.org |url-status=dead |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20110309164542/http://www.iop.org/about/awards/subject/rutherford/medallists/page_38596.html |archive-date=2011-03-09}} </ref>
